authorization: Organization context must resolve through membership; submission requires research:plan in both token and server role. Status reads require dataset:read and tenant RLS.
submission: Requires Idempotency-Key, pinned stored version, proven preservation rights and approved native variable. Typed region/time validation limits requests to 31 days. Optional as_of is an explicit UTC analysis cutoff; the requested interval cannot extend beyond it, the pinned source version must have been retrieved and established available by it, and future cutoffs are rejected. Submission returns 503 unless application state explicitly enables an acquisition worker.
durability: Requests persist in PostgreSQL. Workers claim under SKIP LOCKED, receive expiring fencing tokens, and can recover expired leases. Late completions cannot overwrite recovered attempts. Success requires a snapshot from the same tenant and version.
cache: Completed immutable snapshots are reused only when tenant and exact acquisition request digest match. The digest includes organization, product/version and source/license evidence plus geometry, interval, variables, depth and as_of. Every submission still validates current rights and endpoint authorization. Unit-level cache hit/miss and isolated local PostgreSQL acquisition/snapshot persistence checks pass; remote recovery acceptance remains deferred.
pending: Production executor configuration, source-specific geometry/index bounds and content validation, project entitlements, concurrency stress tests and full G03 remain unfinished. Request digest binding and atomic worker publication are implemented; see P03-acquisition-worker.json.
baseline: Historical deferral is superseded. Preserved real MUR baseline input compatibility passed; no scientific method validity claim.
